summary: Per-source counts, the bulletin and the search-fed Explore figures leave articles still queued for screening out of every count and say how many they did not count; lists and the LIST's facet options keep every result. The Home total keeps counting every article and shows what it holds (quarantined, not screened yet, not analysed yet); an unread backlog is absent, never 0. The re-index backlog is worded as 'not analysed yet' and says some derived rows may be missing, since a partly re-indexed article can carry keywords but no places. The engine report labels its maintained counters as raw, including unscreened articles; those counters stay unconverted. Strings x12.
